security_code.description: Exact requested security code; do not infer a different issuer.
security_code.title: Security Code

company_name_ja.description: Japanese company name stated in the latest supplied filing.
company_name_ja.title: Company Name Ja

company_name_en.description: English company name stated in the supplied filings, or a faithful romanization when no English name is shown.
company_name_en.title: Company Name En

latest_filename.description: Exact authoritative filename of the filing identified as latest.
latest_filename.title: Latest Filename

latest_period_ja.description: Concise Japanese reporting-period label for the latest filing.
latest_period_ja.title: Latest Period Ja

ResearchCapitalAllocationTrack.description: Capital destination followed from input through later economic returns.

track_label_ja.description: Short label for a business, asset category, investment program, distribution program, or other capital destination.
track_label_ja.title: Track Label Ja

stated_rationale_ja.description: Management's stated purpose when disclosed, or null for a capital accumulation pattern inferred directly from reported balances.
stated_rationale_ja.title: Stated Rationale Ja

capital_inputs.description: Disclosed observations showing capital directed to or released from this destination. A track may be a persistent multi-year accumulation without a discrete announced decision.
capital_inputs.title: Capital Inputs

immediate_effects.description: Transaction and accounting effects kept structurally separate from subsequent economic returns.
immediate_effects.title: Immediate Effects

subsequent_returns.description: Later operating or financial returns relevant to the capital absorbed. Revenue growth alone is not sufficient unless profit, margin, cash, productive use, impairment, or exit evidence is also retained.
subsequent_returns.title: Subsequent Returns

adverse_evidence_ja.description: Concise contrary signals such as persistent losses, impairment, delayed utilization, disposal after weak performance, or financial strain.
adverse_evidence_ja.title: Adverse Evidence Ja

record_maturity.description: Whether the selected filing window contains a mature, partial, too recent, or otherwise unobservable return record. This is not a value-creation verdict.

disclosure_limit_ja.description: Material attribution or disclosure limitation, or null when the record is sufficiently specific.
disclosure_limit_ja.title: Disclosure Limit Ja

ResearchCapitalAllocationTrack.title: ResearchCapitalAllocationTrack

ResearchCapitalImmediateEffect.description: Transaction or accounting effect that is not a subsequent return.

effect_ja.description: Purchase price, proceeds, disposal gain or loss, goodwill, financing flow, distribution execution, or another immediate effect. This field must not characterize the effect as proof of an economic return.
effect_ja.title: Effect Ja

ResearchCapitalImmediateEffect.title: ResearchCapitalImmediateEffect

ResearchCapitalInput.description: One disclosed indication that capital was directed to a destination.

amount_or_scale_ja.description: Exact disclosed capital amount, asset balance, spending amount, headcount, capacity, or other scale, or null when only direction is disclosed.
amount_or_scale_ja.title: Amount Or Scale Ja

input_ja.description: What capital was absorbed, released, financed, or distributed and which destination it affected.
input_ja.title: Input Ja

relative_priority_ja.description: Supported evidence that this destination gained, retained, or lost priority relative to other capital uses, or null when no comparative statement is defensible.
relative_priority_ja.title: Relative Priority Ja

ResearchCapitalInput.title: ResearchCapitalInput

ResearchCapitalReturn.description: A later operating or financial return connected to an allocation track.

return_ja.description: Later recurring profit or loss, margin, cash generation, productive use, impairment, or exit evidence relevant to the capital absorbed.
return_ja.title: Return Ja

attribution.description: Use direct for separately disclosed destination-level returns, management_linked when management explicitly connects a wider result to the destination, aggregate_only when only a segment or group result is visible, and unattributed when no connection is stated.

signal.description: Direction of the return evidence, not the final track verdict.

ResearchCapitalReturn.title: ResearchCapitalReturn

ResearchFilingMemo.description: Direct, high-recall summary of one selected filing.

pdf_page_count.description: Physical PDF page count from the supplied document metadata.
pdf_page_count.title: Pdf Page Count

items.description: Decision-useful observations from this filing. Core management discussion is retained even when wording is repetitive.
items.title: Items

unavailable_categories.description: Categories absent or unreadable in this PDF. Do not use this field merely because a section appears routine.
unavailable_categories.title: Unavailable Categories

ResearchFilingMemo.title: ResearchFilingMemo

ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor.description: One comparable annual actual and the next original annual forecast.
ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor.title: ResearchMemoFinancialAnchor

ResearchMemoFinancialPoint.description: One actual or original-forecast value in a year-end filing.
ResearchMemoFinancialPoint.title: ResearchMemoFinancialPoint

ResearchMemoItem.description: One dense filing-specific observation used as an attention guide.

pdf_page.description: Physical 1-indexed PDF page containing the observation.
pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

summary_ja.description: Concise, faithful Japanese summary retaining the original figures, periods, qualifiers, causes, actions, and forecast status needed for later analysis. For capital allocation, prioritize the material decision, its stated purpose, funding or trade-off, and any later operating, profit, margin, cash, capacity, impairment, disposal, debt, liquidity, or distribution outcome. Exact quotation is not required.
summary_ja.title: Summary Ja

ResearchMemoItem.title: ResearchMemoItem

description: Compact chronological research map consumed by synthesis.

filings.description: Exactly one chronological research memo for every selected PDF.
filings.title: Filings

capital_allocation_tracks.description: Compact cross-filing capital-destination records for the most material accumulations, releases, and distributions in the selected period. Capital inputs, immediate effects, and subsequent returns remain separate. These records organize facts for synthesis but do not decide whether value was created. Return an empty list when the selected filings contain no defensible material record.
capital_allocation_tracks.title: Capital Allocation Tracks
